Game Overview

2Player Tanks of War is a two-player title where engage in intense tank duels with a friend across varied battlefields. Navigate and strategize to outmaneuver your opponent, using precise controls and quick reflexes to blast your way to victory. Battle it out for supremacy; the highest scorer wins. Choose your strategy and outgun your rival!
